response.justification: Bogdan Szabo's resume demonstrates strong software development skills, particularly in web, mobile, and embedded systems, with a focus on performance and system architecture. However, his experience lacks direct relevance to hardware optimization, AI accelerators, or SoC/IP modeling, which are core requirements for the Principal Performance Architect role. While he has worked with low-latency systems and Dlang, there is no evidence of deep neural network workload analysis, GPU architecture expertise, or hardware-software co-design experience required for this position.
strengths: Extensive experience in low-latency systems and high-performance computing (e.g., DLang, Asynchronous I/O, fibers)
Proven ability to optimize and architect scalable systems (e.g., micro-services handling millions of requests/sec, pricing optimization at Optilyz)
Strong software engineering fundamentals (TDD, CI/CD, refactoring, open-source contributions)
concerns: No direct experience with SoC/IP modeling, hardware optimization, or AI accelerator architecture
Lacks background in deep neural network training/inference optimization or GPU workload analysis
Educational background (BSc in CS) does not meet the required qualifications (PhD/Master's + years of experience or equivalent) for the Principal-level role
